svg.title: Realistic cross-sections: tongue tip forward and slightly back
svg.desc: Two mouth cross-sections show the teeth, hard palate and tongue. On the left the tongue tip rests forward; on the right it lifts slightly back. Tongue positions are illustrative only, with no need to curl hard.
svg.text: Note where teeth, hard palate and tongue sit.
Move the tip lightly; don't curl it too hard.
Pair this with listening and the teacher's demo.
